score_semantics: All expert, candidate, line, and threshold values are relative utilities, not calibrated probabilities.

candidate_engine.composite_experts_excluded: Existing synergy composites are excluded to avoid counting their base signals twice.

fixed_pool_policy.rationale: Pre-registered compromise: 70% compression with 3003 possible lines; not selected from the historical winner.
fixed_pool_policy.assembly_diagnostic_reason: K=20 is retained separately because K=15 yielded no historical target with three winners available to assemble.
fixed_pool_policy.dynamic_selection: disabled until enough prospective targets exist

interaction_audit.decision: No empirical pair or triple term is enabled; use shrunk expert-factor coherence as the safer proxy.

coalition_engine.objective: 3/4/5 elementary-threshold utility plus line-level specialist mixture minus disagreement and near-duplicate penalties

powerball.architecture: independent 1-16 shrunk rank aggregation; no cross-chamber coupling
powerball.coupling_gate: Require a preregistered conditional test with out-of-sample lift over the independent PB ranker before coupling.
